gloss_en.text: well, hmm; Used to express acceptance of one's misfortune; oh well, welp

gloss_zh.text: （無實際意義，常表否定語氣，如懷疑）

examples.de: Was schlägst du vor? — Tja, ich schlage vor, dass wir ins Kino gehen.
examples.en: What do you suggest? — Well, I suggest that we go to the movies.
Oh well! That didn’t work out as planned...
